_README: VG3 cid3 model parameters. Numerical values are combined with DEFAULT_LOCKED_PARAMS in src/vg3_base_functions.py; fitted size-tuning parameters are loaded from data/fitted/.
_reversals: Excitatory and inhibitory reversal potentials, mV.
_synaptic_weights: Weights in uS per synapse. The simulation scripts use fitted weights from data/fitted/ and multiply them by G_EXC and G_INH in base_functions.py.
_kinetics: Single-event Exp2Syn kinetics: excitation 10/300 ms; inhibition 20/300 ms.
_stimulus: Gaussian-blurred spot; sigma = bipolar RF size.
_fitted_exc_on: ON EPSC two-Hill fit (2_fit_on_epscs); on_scale fixed.
_fitted_inh: Inhibition fit (3_fit_inhibition); A_off=1, A_on<1; inh_weight_fitted is the effective per-synapse weight.
_surround_hill: These Hill values are disabled in run_functions.run_spot; stimulus size tuning instead uses the fitted gains in data/fitted/.
